rules.provenance: Components with non-empty requiredFacts render ONLY when those facts are VERIFIED (present in the creative brief / _brand.json / research pack with a real source) — never fabricate a fact to unlock a section. No invented menu items, prices, products, named people, quotes, stats, live counts, logos/press relationships, timeline events, FAQ pairs, case studies, or donate links. When a required fact is missing, site-generation does NOT select the component; most components also self-hide via the scrubText/isPlaceholder/hasRealImage firewall (src/lib/placeholders.ts) as defense-in-depth — but the firewall is the backstop, not the gate.
rules.selection: Site-generation picks components by EVIDENCE in the creative brief: match each entry's `scenario` to the visitor job the page serves, then confirm every `requiredFacts` key is verified before selecting. Prefer a smaller honest section over a bigger fabricated one.
rules.budgets: budget.maxKbJs = gzipped JS ceiling for the component plus its exclusive helper deps. budget.maxKbImg = combined image-transfer ceiling for the section at 1280w (0 = renders no images). Route-level ceilings still apply on top (JS <= 200KB gz per route).
